text:
Symbioen monitors and verifies the performance of public and private EV chargers. 

Measuring charging performance is difficult because every operator defines it differently. Symbioen measures this gap between what operators claim and what chargers actually deliver — leaving customers overcharged, investors working from inflated figures, and procurement teams unable to compare numbers across networks.

To mitigate such risks Symbioen provides EV charging KPIs that use open regulatory data as a common foundation. Any network, operator, or region can then be compared against the same baseline. 


For operators, Symbioen offers independent proof of network performance in front of customers, partners, and procurement teams. Investors and public bodies share a related need: comparable, objective data — covering due diligence and portfolio monitoring on the investment side, and cross-regional performance tracking on the public side. Site hosts and EV fleets use the same KPI data to hold charging providers accountable — and Symbioen's reports, covering both individual site metrics and aggregated regional trends, give them the documentation to do it. 


For questions, partnerships, or access to public or private reports, reach out at vadim@symbioen.com or visit symbioen.com.
